_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Nekk d Amurar {player_id} deg Tic Tac Toe s Kra n Yimurar.
Asekkil-ik d '{symbol}'.
Tettekkiḍ tikelt s tikelt ad tesɛeddeḍ asekkil-ik ɣef uḍebsi 5x5 akken ad tesɛeddeḍ azur n kkuẓ.
Izuren zemren ad illin s waɛrur, neɣ s tazzla, neɣ s aɣensu.
Azen aɣawas-ik s useɣẓan '[4]' akken ad tesɛeddeḍ takarḍa 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: ⵓⵔ ⵉⴳⵉ ⵓⴽⵛⵓⵎ ⵏ ⵜⵍⵖⴰ. ⵙⵔⵙ "[cell]" ⴳ ⵡⴰⴷⴷⴰⴷ ⵏⵏⴰ ⴷⴰⵔ ⵜⴰⵡⵊⵉⵡⵉⵏ 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Aṭas n tcella yagi: {cell}. Ilhaq ad yili gar n 0 ed {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: ⵢⵉⵡⵙ ⵡⵓⵔⴰⵔ {player_id} ⴳ ⵢⴰⵜ ⵜⵎⵀⵍⵜ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉⵏ.
